## hurricane-melissa-2025__README.md
# Planet Crisis Response — Hurricane Melissa, Jamaica (2025)

High-resolution **Planet SkySat** imagery of **Hurricane Melissa**'s impact on Jamaica.
Melissa made landfall in southwestern Jamaica on **28 October 2025** as a catastrophic
Category 5 hurricane. The catalog pairs **post-event** collects (~0.8 m GSD, acquired
**3–4 November 2025** over the landfall zone) with a **pre-event** SkySat baseline
(**October 2023** — the most recent cloud-free SkySat of these locations before the storm)
for before/after comparison.

- 🛰️ **Live data & catalog:** <https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/>
- 🧭 **Browse:** [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json)
- 🤖 **For agents:** [`llms.txt`](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/llms.txt)
- Imagery © Planet Labs PBC — **CC BY-NC 4.0** (non-commercial).

## Structure

The catalog is split into **post-event** and **pre-event**, each organised by **affected location**:

```
catalog.json                          root
post-event/catalog.json               post-event sub-catalog
  savanna-la-mar/collection.json      14 scenes (Westmoreland, 2025-11-03)
  black-river/collection.json         7 scenes (St. Elizabeth, 2025-11-04)
pre-event/catalog.json                pre-event baseline sub-catalog
  savanna-la-mar/collection.json      22 scenes (2023-10-21, cloud-free)
  black-river/collection.json         19 scenes (2023-10-11, cloud-free)
    items/<scene>/<scene>.json         one STAC Item per SkySat scene
    items/<scene>/<scene>_*.tif        the COGs (see assets below)
```

The pre-event baseline is ~2 years before landfall — the most recent clear SkySat available
over these towns (no closer-in-time SkySat was tasked here before the storm).

Each Item merges the four Planet bundles ordered for this scene into one record, with
de-duplicated masks. Asset keys:

| Asset key | Product | Bands |
|---|---|---|
| `visual` | Visual true-colour ortho COG | RGB (8-bit) |
| `pansharpened` | Pansharpened ortho COG | BGRN |
| `udm2` | Usable Data Mask (per-pixel quality) | — |
| `udm` | Unusable Data Mask | — |

Per-collection `items.parquet` (STAC-GeoParquet) indexes are provided for each collection
and as a `post-event/` aggregate.
